summary: Renames formatPrice to formatMoney with a currency argument and uses Intl.NumberFormat. invoiceLines now takes an optional currency that defaults to USD.

findings.title: Removed formatPrice still imported by cart
findings.problem: This change removes the formatPrice export from money.ts. The file src/cart.ts still imports formatPrice on line 1 and calls it on line 8.
findings.consequence: The TypeScript build fails on cart.ts, so the cart total cannot compile or render. Every customer checkout path that shows cartTotal breaks.
findings.fix: Update cartTotal in cart.ts to call formatMoney with a currency. Another option is to keep formatPrice as a wrapper that calls formatMoney with USD.

findings.title: Changed money formatting has no covering test
findings.problem: formatMoney now formats with Intl.NumberFormat, which adds thousands separators and supports other currencies. No test in the repository exercises formatMoney or invoiceLines.
findings.consequence: Developers will not notice regressions in invoice text or currency output. Removed exports such as formatPrice also go unnoticed.
findings.fix: Add tests for formatMoney and invoiceLines that cover USD, a non-USD currency and amounts above one thousand.
